title: Douglas County Courthouse
credit: National Park Service, National Register of Historic Places, NRIS 75000708
alt_text: Douglas County Courthouse, Lawrence, Douglas County, Kansas
notes: Rooms run 2026-10-20. Chapter 6 (becoming a citizen): NAI-F-0064 (disputed) says Naismith became a citizen in the District Court of Douglas County, Kansas, on May 4, 1925. National Register photographs PDF (8 pages; 1974 exterior views by Kansas State Historical Society staff per the nomination; page images about 1575 x 1066 px). The courthouse was completed in 1904 (nomination text). No source on file says the district court sat in this building in 1925; the adversary must judge the depiction against the fact's place. The asset page's Copyright Information field is empty: rights unknown, reference only.
